remaining_gaps.topic: An explicit grant of Elements is repeated, unlike printed margin Elements
remaining_gaps.proposed_question: A legally used Elemental Boon grants Elements through its effect text. It is then legally Repeated using Powerstorm. Does its explicit Element-grant instruction happen again, and are the card’s printed margin Elements gained again?
remaining_gaps.predetermined_answer: The explicit Element-grant instruction happens again, so its benefit can be received twice. Repeating does not grant the card’s printed margin Elements again; those were gained when the card was played.
minimum_asked_facts: Repeat resolves the explicit Element-grant effect again.
Printed margin Elements are not gained again.

question.question: What is the difference between a Growth Move Presence arrow and Add Presence using an island disk? Can the latter pick up a disk outside the shown Range of the destination?

key.answer: Move measures from that disk’s present land and moves up to the arrow’s distance. Add/reposition first picks a legal destination measured from any existing Presence, then may take any own island disk, even one far from that destination. It remains adding, not a Move instruction.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What is the difference between a Growth Move Presence arrow and Add Presence using an island disk? Can the latter pick up a disk outside the shown Range of the destination?
required_facts: Growth Move Presence measures up to the indicated distance from that disk's current land.
Add Presence using an island disk first selects a destination measured from existing Presence.
It may then take an island disk from anywhere, even outside the shown destination Range.
Repositioning under Add is adding rather than a Move instruction.

question.question: When a Fast Gift of Strength or Powerstorm grants a Repeat, must the card be chosen immediately? Can the chosen card be Slow, can it be an innate, and do you gain its printed Elements again?

key.answer: Choose eligible Power Card when actually repeating, not necessarily at grant time. Slow cards can be repeated in Slow; these two effects specify cards and cannot repeat Innates. Printed card Elements are not granted again; explicit Elements in the repeated text are granted again.

question.question: If a Power’s Range was increased and it was made Fast, what happens on Repeat? If Elements enabling a non-Range threshold have been lost, does the Repeat automatically retain that threshold?

key.answer: Range/speed modifications carry over, so Repeat retains extended Range and Fast speed. Thresholds otherwise check current Elements; losing them may mean a previously met threshold no longer applies.

Other thresholds check current Elements and may no longer apply after Elements are lost.

question.question: What happens when Powerstorm itself is Repeated, and can its threshold spend all three Repeat permissions on the same Power Card?

key.answer: Repeat instructions on a repeated Power are ignored, so repeating Powerstorm grants no Repeat permissions; its non-Repeat Energy gain still happens. Its threshold allows up to three different Power Cards, not the same one three times.

question.question: When an action directly grants a flexible Any Element, may its choice be delayed like an Any space on a Presence track?

key.answer: No. Directly gained flexible Elements must be chosen immediately when gained; passive track Any can wait until later in turn, then is fixed for that turn.

key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The contrast asks whether the directly gained Element choice may be delayed, like a track Any. It does not ask whether an already chosen track Element can be changed.

question.question: A Spirit plays two Power Cards and later Repeats one. For an effect counting Power Cards played, such as Boon of Vigor, is the count two or three? Does the Repeat consume another ordinary Card Play, and does it nevertheless count as a new Power use?

key.answer: Two cards played: a Repeat does not play another Power Card and adds no card to that count. It nevertheless counts as a new Power use. It consumes no additional ordinary Card Play; any payment required by a Repeat permission is separate.

question.question: A Spirit with no Energy remaining receives Gift of Strength and has already used an eligible cost-1 Power Card. May it use that card's Repeat without paying its cost again, or does Gift require the same repayment as Powerstorm?

key.answer: Yes. The eligible Gift of Strength Repeat can be used with no Energy remaining. Its printed cost limit is an eligibility limit, not a payment instruction. Powerstorm’s separate explicit repayment condition does not apply to Gift.

question.question: When Spirits May Yet Dream grants its target an Element, may that Spirit choose an Element it currently has none of, or must the chosen Element already be present?

question.question: Bringer uses Tsunami with its threshold. Its base Damage would destroy a Town, so that Town is Pushed into an adjacent other Coastal land on the same board. Tsunami’s threshold later deals Damage in that land. Counting only nightmare-destruction Fear from that same Town, can it produce that Fear again during this single Tsunami use, or only once?

key.answer: Only once. Moving the same Town into another land affected later by this Tsunami does not reset the single-Power, single-Invader limit.
